column1: # Reviewed map: changed path glob -> the ONLY tests the pre-commit hook runs.
# Format and semantics: see the header of ci/tools/precommit-tests.sh.
# ci/tools/lint-precommit-map.py fails when a src/*.c, areas/*.py or unit
# check/test/extract file has no row here: a new file must be mapped, not
# silently left unchecked. No row may call run_all(), test_runtime.py or
# ci/tests/unit/run.sh (a whole suite); that is asserted by the selector tests.
# --- src/<unit>.c -> its unit targets + matching runtime area ---------------
